about: Layer 3 of rachel/search-normalize.js (DC, Nov 20): the ONLY words the zero-result spell check may correct a typed word to. Fixed list, edited by hand — never learned from searches. Each word is a catalog category (Wine / Beer / Liquor) or a type word rachel/drink-type.js and rachel/spirit-type.js already use to classify catalog rows. 5+ letters only: shorter targets (gin, rum, rye, ale, ipa, rose, brut, noir, blanc, gris, franc, wine, beer) sit too close to real brand words.
